assets.name: walk
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the edit target: a 16-frame side-view blacksteel knight locomotion atlas, 8 columns and 2 rows. Image 2 is ONLY the identity and anatomy reference: use the slim standing knight in the TOP ROW; do not use its hurt, fallen or crouching poses.
Primary correction: the edit target has become squat and bulky compared with the standing knight. Redraw all sixteen complete figures with the reference knight's lean, tall adult proportions. About 20 percent smaller helmet, close-fitting angular chest armor, a clearly narrower flat waist, slim hips and long lean thighs and shins. Remove the thick rounded belly, barrel chest, swollen upper legs, oversized mitts and heavy rounded boots. The result must look like the SAME slender adult knight when he starts or stops moving, not a different stocky character. Keep enough armor to remain heroic: black steel, restrained brass edging, deep crimson cape, closed angular helmet with a small cyan visor slit.
Preserve the original full two-step animation: all sixteen distinct leg/contact/passing poses in the same chronological order, alternating near and far legs. Keep the foot contact timing, limb bending directions, horizontal pelvis anchor in every cell and consistent standing-height envelope; adjust the anatomy by redrawing, not squeezing/stretching whole pictures. Raise the waist slightly to give the legs the same long-legged proportion as the standing reference. Keep the same character identity, scale, head size, shoulder width and waist width from frame to frame. Preserve a single low-carried sword pointing backward LEFT, and the cape behind the torso. No new equipment.
Output one transparent PNG atlas, exactly EIGHT equal columns and TWO equal rows, sixteen full figures facing RIGHT, same layout and spacing as image 1. Every pose fully separated, weapons and feet inside its cell. No floor, shadows, scenery, frame labels, numbers, borders or glow. Crisp game-sprite painting designed to reduce cleanly to a 60-pixel-tall native sprite.
This sheet is WALKING: tall upright spine, level shoulders, natural gentle opposite-arm swing, no crouched or running posture. Preserve the complete heel-contact, weight-transfer, passing and opposite-foot-contact sequence.

assets.name: walk-unarmed
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Make the UNARMED variant of this exact 16-frame knight animation atlas. Change ONLY the weapon: remove every sword blade, hilt and guard; turn the near hand into a small relaxed empty fist. Preserve every figure's EXACT slim adult anatomy, helmet size, shoulder and waist width, long legs, body position, individual leg pose, pose order, cape, armor colors, every cell placement, figure size and transparent background. Do not bulk up, shorten, round off or re-proportion the body. Do not change the full alternating two-step cycle or turn walking into running. The same knight and same 16 poses with weapons removed, not a new character. Same 8-column by 2-row atlas, transparent PNG, no weapons, floor, shadows, added props, text, numbers or labels.
